page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head and page number at the top. A marginal note in the left margin beside the first section, and another beside the paragraph on "criminantibus". The catchword "Igitur" at the lower right. Section headings are numbered with bare Roman numerals and carry titles in larger type.

main_text.p: communicare vires & consilia possent, in plures po-pulos diffectis, matrimonia & commercia plerisque interdicta. Haud satis commodè Albanus, domitis ut arbitrabatur Belgis, inveterato Hispani nominis odio exactionum gravitatem, decimam rerum venalium, adjunxit, quæ causa ultima, & cum effectu, Belgarum defectionis.
main_text.head: Acriori morsu domestica quam externa imperii detractatio imperantis animum vellicat.
main_text.p: Germanicus turbidis rebus Armeniam, dubiis Domesticus contemptus.Cappadocas, Comagenos, Cilicas exemerat. Cunctaq; socialia prosperè composita, non ideò latum Germani-cum habebant ob superbiam Pisonis, qui jussu partem legionum ipse, aut per filium in Armeniam ducere, utrumque neglexerat. Vide cætera de conventu Pisonis & Germanici, illius obfirmato animo, & precum contumacia, sermonum dissensione, luxus obliqua exprobratione apud autorem.
main_text.head: Faces offensionum sufurrones amici.
main_text.p: Non Tiberius tantùm, fenilis ætatis vitio suspicax, sed & Germanicus, juventæ calore erectior, patulas Cave amicos.criminantibus aures præbebat. Amici accendendis offensionibus callidi, intendere vera, adgerere falsa, ipsumque & Plancinam, & filios variis modis criminari. quibus contra demenda rumoris inania, extenuanda quæ levia viderentur, erant. Acuminis est veram rationem apud sapientes non inventuri, morbo pec-cantem humorem, incendio pabulum adjicere. Sed dum sibi quisque gratiæ augmentum captat, nec amici tranquillitati, nec publicis rebus confulitur.
main_text.head: Multum precibus in aula, plus alio-rum contumeliæ damus.

page.notes: Marginal note "Domesticus contemptus." (two lines) at the left beside "Cappadocas". Marginal note "Cave amicos." at the left beside "criminantibus". Doubtful readings: "Cunctaq;" (the abbreviation is read as q;), "demenda" and "inventuri" (copied as seen), "diffectis" (ct ligature). Long s was normalised to s throughout. Text in the first and second paragraphs is set in roman; italic run in CXXX is marked with <i>.
